## About Guust
Guust Taillieu is a 23-year-old full-stack developer who crafts user-friendly and functional software, balancing front-end and back-end engineering. When not coding, Guust enjoys bouldering, exploring nature, and building personal projects.

## Services
1. **Web Development**: Creating modern, performant, and responsive web applications using cutting-edge technologies like Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
2. **UI/UX Design**: Designing clean, intuitive, and modern interfaces in Figma and prototyping interactive user journeys.
3. **Mentoring & Tutoring**: Over 4 years of experience tutoring and mentoring students in programming, cybersecurity, and computer science concepts.
4. **Cyber Security**: Practical security expertise specializing in application security, penetration testing fundamentals, and defensive engineering.
